expires_today.title: Industrial Lands
expires_today.description: 600+ assets to create massive industrial worlds
expires_today.long_description:
Create sprawling factories, diesel-powered districts, heavy construction sites, and mechanized battlefields with the Industrial Lands Bundle by KitBash3D. Packed with industrial environments, bold architecture, armored structures, construction machinery, and powerful mechs, this collection is made for developing worlds with weight, scale, and grit. Build everything from hard-working cityscapes to dystopian strongholds and sci-fi warzones with production-ready assets designed to drop into your workflow. Compatible with Blender, Unreal, and more—these Hollywood-quality assets are ready to elevate your next project to new heights. Plus, your purchase helps support Make-A-Wish!

Keys expire. Please redeem before October 28th, 2026.

expires_today.title: Self-Reliance and Off-Grid Skills for Dummies
expires_today.long_description: Don’t just survive in the modern outdoors—thrive. Our newest For Dummies bundle features some of the hottest and most useful ebooks for individuals looking to have fun in the wild or start a craft career. Get amazing titles like Solar Power Your Home For Dummies, 2e, Vegetable Gardening For Dummies, 3e, How to Fix Everything For Dummies, and Ham Radio For Dummies, 4e. Plus, your purchase helps support Covenant House.

expires_today.title: Image in the '20s: A Megabundle by Image Comics
expires_today.long_description: The decade may only be half over, but the 2020s have been good to Image Comics, one of the most exciting publishers of the day that is consistently putting out great stuff. To celebrate Image’s recent successes, we’ve put together a megabundle of their best series, so that longtime fans and new readers can find their new favorite stories! This bundle includes collected volumes of tech dystopian superhero story The Dead Lucky, rural Canadian horror series Fishflies, intergalactic warrior drama Free Agents, geriatric battle royale action series Golden Rage, child vampire saga Little Monsters, and more! If those sound good to you, just wait to see what else is in store in this giant—and we mean giant—bundle of Image’s best new comics! Grab them now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Embedded Firmware Developer Toolkit by Packt
expires_today.description: Build, Program, and Master the Brains behind Modern Devices
expires_today.long_description: Take control of the hardware that powers the modern world with this hands-on embedded systems toolkit from Packt! Dive deep into microcontrollers, ARM Cortex-M development, RTOS, and embedded Linux as you build the skills needed to design, program, and optimize real-world devices. Whether you're an aspiring firmware engineer or an experienced developer expanding into embedded systems, this bundle equips you to write efficient code, manage hardware, and bring intelligent devices to life, while supporting charity with your purchase.

expires_today.title: Freedom to Create with COREL Graphics Suite 2025
expires_today.long_description:
Feel like your graphic design projects could use a little more pizzazz? Take your art to the next level with the 2025 edition of CorelDRAW Graphics Suite—professional quality graphic design software with all the bells and whistles. For a massive discount you’ll get everything this CorelDRAW suite has to offer, from vector illustration software, image processing, font and layout managers, and more! Whether you’re creating your own art pieces or designing for a brand, these programs will help you bring your ideas to life and give them energy and style. You won’t find a deal this good for software this essential anywhere else, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support Extra Life charity through Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.description: Unleash your creativity with CAD Pro 14!

expires_tomorrow.title: Miniseries, Quick Hits, and Speedy Reads by Dynamite Comics
expires_tomorrow.description: Adventures you can read in one sitting
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Got a hankering for a new comic series but not really in the mood for something that’ll take ages to finish? This bundle from Dynamite Comics is full of short but sweet tales of the fantastic! Hop aboard a farcical action-romance with plenty of unexpected turns in Garth Ennis’ A Train Called Love! Irradiated rodents take the world by storm in Adolescent Radioactive Black Belt Hamsters! The pin-up queen returns for a rural Ireland adventure in Bettie Page and The Curse of the Banshee! Plus, catch up with classic heroes and heroines like John Carter and Red Sonja! All of this and more is included in this megabundle of mini-adventures, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support the Comic Book Legal Defense Fund with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Shantae & Heroic Heroines

expires_within_72h.title: Tales From the Iron Kingdoms
expires_within_72h.description: Step into a world forged in steam and iron and tempered by war
expires_within_72h.long_description:
In Warmachine the earth shakes during fierce confrontations between six-ton constructs of iron and steel clash with the devastating force of a locomotive, towering warbeasts hurl themselves at their foes in a frenzy of claw and fang, and bold heroes set the battlefield ablaze with with a tempest of of arcane magic as they forge the fate of nations in the fires of destruction.

Immerse yourself in Warmachine lore with this bundle of novels and short story anthologies, set in iconic locations and telling the stories of heroes, villains, and some of the Iron Kingdoms' most pivotal events. Collect each volume of the Iron Kingdoms Excursions, Warcaster Chronicles, Warlock Sagas, and Called to Battle series and more as you learn the backstories of key characters like The Butcher of Khardov and encounter a wealth of different peoples and cultures.

Grab this 41-ebook bundle at the price of your choice, and support the Child's Play charity with your purchase!

Also returning by popular demand is a collection of 65 Iron Kingdoms RPG (IKRPG) items, including core and source books for the Full Metal Fantasy and 5e editions, GM toolkits, bestiary's, and maps, first presented in the March 2025 Iron Kingdoms Humble Bundle.

A world of adventure and full metal fantasy awaits in the Iron Kingdoms.
